meeting.name: Meeting Shortcut
meeting.description: Starts or stops transcribing a meeting: your microphone and the computer's audio, saved as it goes.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.deleteConfirm: Delete this whole meeting? Audio, original transcript and AI-generated content will be removed. This cannot be undone.
meetings.unfinished: The meeting was interrupted before the transcript was finished. What was said is saved.
meetings.aiPending: Pending: transcript review, summary and minutes
meetings.providerMissing: Set a provider, model and API key in Post Processing.
meetings.textOnly: Only the transcript text is sent, never the audio. The original transcript is not changed.
meetings.redoConfirm: Delete the AI-generated content and generate it again with {{model}}? The original transcript stays intact.
meetings.deleteAiConfirm: Delete the summary, minutes and revised transcript? The original transcript and audio stay intact, and you can generate them again later (even with another model).

learnedWords.title: Learned Words
learnedWords.description: Re-transcribes unread dictations from the history with a more accurate downloaded model and asks the post-processing AI which terms the current model got wrong. The words found apply only to that model, and the number next to each counts the dictations it got it wrong in: the most misheard come first and are the last to go when the list fills up. Click a word to fix its spelling. Only text goes to the AI, never audio.
learnedWords.noReference: No more accurate model downloaded to compare these models' dictations

suspects.title: To review ({{count}})
suspects.description: Terms the AI saw were wrong or out of context but couldn't correct, like an internal product name. Type the right word to have it learned, or dismiss it.

meeting.stopNothingHint: Audio and live transcript are kept; finish it later from History
meeting.participantsHint: Names separated by commas, yours first. The AI uses them in the summary and minutes.
